why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open minehood.io , the only site linked from @minehood_rh, and press Connect X. The site warns that "X's own sign in page lists wider read access because X offers no narrower choice for this kind of sign in. We use none of it."
Follow @minehood_rh, then like, reply to and repost the task post, confirming each one on the site.
Press Join the waitlist, then check @minehood_rh for new task posts, which add XP.
Wait for the game. The site says: "We will reach out on X when the doors open."
costs: The waitlist is free: it needs an X account and a public wallet address, with no payment and no gas. For the game, the FAQ says "Walking the Central Hub, meeting the NPCs and taking the portals cost nothing", and "Sword and armor upgrades and crafting cost only resources." It also says "deposits are plain transfers you send yourself", without giving an amount or a token. Gas on Robinhood Chain is
risks: There are no terms of use, no country list and no age limit. The only legal text is a short privacy section. The site says it keeps "your X account id, your @handle (also your name on the list), your public wallet address and when you marked a task done. Nothing else."
